# Entidade–Contrato Checklist: Gate de Conformidade (Schema Test na Aplicação Gerada)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade, clareza, consistência e completude dos requisitos da feature de conformidade entidade–contrato — unidade de teste da própria especificação, não da implementação.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Escopo desta execução**: passada ampla, executada ANTES de `plan.md` existir (decisão do revisor). Por isso os itens avaliam apenas `spec.md` + `.specify/memory/constitution.md`; nenhum item pressupõe decisão de design ainda não tomada.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the activation conditions of the generated schema test fully enumerated, including the exact persisted-contract path that triggers it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the removal of the test class specified for every non-activating configuration (absent flag, `none`, `null`, empty, invalid path, disabled test tree)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are both conformance directions (contrato→entidade and entidade→contrato) specified with comparable depth and explicit expected outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the complete set of meta-keys excluded from attribute classification documented, including `attributes` and `fields`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are type-resolution rules documented for declared `java.lang` types, declared project types, and rejected declared types that fall back to value estimation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements present for nested types at multiple depths and for enum constants compared against the contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK007 Are all required diagnostic fields (attribute, expected type, found type/absence, direction, file, test, structural failure) specified as mandatory message content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "campo técnico de identidade" defined unambiguously, including its name pattern and Java type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the mapping between the contract `id` key and the technical identity field stated without competing alternatives? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "mesmas regras de estimativa de tipo" anchored to an observable, enumerable rule set instead of tacit knowledge? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "ordem determinística" for an aggregated failure defined precisely enough to reproduce the same output on any machine? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "falha estrutural explícita" for a missing or unreadable contract stated in observable terms (failure, never skip or pass)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the scope of "meta-chaves" explicit for both flat-form and `attributes`/`fields` contracts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "100% fiel ao contrato" operationalized into checkable predicates rather than kept as an adjective? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the activation rules agree with the edge-case statements about a disabled test tree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the requirement that the verdict must not depend on generated boilerplate consistent with the Lombok-on/off parity criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Does FR-004 avoid demanding entity fields for the keys that FR-005 classifies as meta-keys? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the success criteria consistent with the negative journeys (no orphan test, no new dependency)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the "no new user-facing flag" constraint consistent with every activation statement in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can every success criterion be verified without inspecting implementation internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-008]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the 15-profile green criterion traceable to an explicit, named list of profiles? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "nenhuma dependência nova" measurable through an observable artifact comparison? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK023 Are acceptance scenarios defined for both the green path and the sabotage path of the delivery proof? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are alternate flows covered for contracts that declare an explicit `type` versus contracts that rely solely on value estimation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Are contract-missing-at-generation-time and contract-missing-at-test-runtime defined as distinct scenarios with distinct expected outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the recovery expectation defined after a developer fixes a drift (subsequent run returns to green)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for a persisted contract that carries zero business attributes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for the `id` key being absent from the contract, including non-classification of the technical field as a stray field? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK029 Are case-only differences in attribute names specified, including which side's canonical form prevails? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK030 Are arrays/collections specified with an explicit expected behavior rather than an open delegation? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Are enum constant mismatches specified for both removal and rename, in either direction? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK032 Is behavior specified when a contract key does not satisfy the Java identifier pattern expected by the mechanism? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Is the dependence on the inference mechanism's rules documented together with a guard against the two rule sets drifting apart? [Dependency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption that persisted contracts never carry flag keys validated or explicitly bounded? [Assumption, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the tooling constraint (no new dependency, contract consumed as-is) stated in a testable way? [Dependency, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK036 Are environment assumptions of the archetype-side delivery proof (Frente 02) documented? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 Is it clear which accepted contract shapes the generated test must interpret (flat form, `attributes` object, `attributes` array, list of strings, `fields`)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the precedence between an `attributes`/`fields` collection and loose top-level fields documented? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 Is it specified whether enums are compared by type name, by constant set, or both? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK040 Is "veredito idêntico" under Lombok on/off defined precisely enough to compare two runs? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Completeness (Segunda passada)

- [ ] CHK041 Are type-resolution requirements defined for `attributes` entries declared as a bare list of strings (name only, with no value to estimate from)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK042 Are requirements defined for duplicate attribute names, including the mechanism's renaming/discarding rule? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK043 Are requirements defined for nested objects that the mechanism degrades to `String` (empty object, invalid type name, no valid field, depth limit)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK044 Are requirements defined for project-type attributes whose Java name derives from the type (e.g., `Convenio` → `convenio`) instead of from the contract key? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity (Segunda passada)

- [ ] CHK045 Is the ordering rule for the aggregated failure message stated explicitly (e.g., contract order), rather than only as "deterministic"? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK046 Is "o teste que falhou" defined for a schema test implemented as a single class with multiple test methods? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK047 Is the effective attribute set (after meta-key exclusion, invalid-key discard and duplicate handling) given a canonical term and definition? [Clarity, Terminology, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-009]

## Edge Case Coverage (Segunda passada)

- [ ] CHK048 Is behavior specified for an empty contract object (no attributes and no collections)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK049 Is behavior specified for enum-looking arrays that fall back to `String` (empty, mixed case, non-string items)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK050 Is behavior specified when the contract is reformatted without semantic change (key order, whitespace), given the persistence is byte-identical but the test reads semantically? [Edge Case, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions (Segunda passada)

- [ ] CHK051 Is the sabotage procedure for the Frente 02 proof specified at requirements level (copy vs in-place, reversibility, scope)? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK052 Is the assumption that archetype and generated test share the same type/naming rules backed by any verification mechanism? [Assumption, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- This checklist was generated before `plan.md` existed; it intentionally tests only the written requirements
- Items CHK026, CHK032, CHK036, CHK037, CHK038 and CHK039 are marked as `[Gap]`/`[Ambiguity]` because the current spec does not settle them explicitly — they are the prime candidates for a follow-up `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Segunda passada (2026-11-13, após novo `/speckit.clarify`): CHK037, CHK038 e CHK039 foram resolvidos na spec; a nota anterior permanece como registro histórico. Os itens CHK041–CHK052 cobrem as decisões novas e as lacunas que ainda restam.
